bio: With over a decade of experience bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI research and practical enterprise applications, Eleanor Vance helps forward-thinking organizations navigate the complexities of AI adoption. She specializes in developing tailored strategies that drive innovation, optimize operations, and create sustainable competitive advantages in an increasingly automated world.

services.name: is322 midterm
services.description: A comprehensive evaluation of your organization's current data infrastructure, technical capabilities, and business processes to determine your readiness for AI integration.

services.name: Custom AI Strategy Development
